statements.status_notes: The DHI cups package is based on CUPS 2.4.10, which no longer contains the legacy scheduler/dirsvc.c process_browse_data and BrowseShortNames code path targeted by the Red Hat patch at https://bugzilla.redhat.com/attachment.cgi?id=916761. The remaining printer and class add paths in scheduler/ipp.c already validate names with validate_name before accepting them.

The DHI cups package backports the upstream SNMP string bounds fix from https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/b7c2525a885f528d243c3a92197ca99609b3f080 as dhi-cve-2026-41079-limit-snmp-string-length.patch, which allocates a terminator byte and caps num_bytes to the copied SNMP string buffer length.

The DHI cups package backports the upstream per-printer subscription expiration fix from https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/0142eeb58e0d718b7d2e1f0d5dd214bd2192cc7f as dhi-cve-2026-39316-expire-printer-subscriptions.patch, which expires subscriptions before deleting a printer.

The DHI cups package backports the upstream job-password-supported range check from https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/928a86b1b794f738f0a3dc87561b2e054bff7ce4 as dhi-cve-2026-39314-job-password-supported-range.patch, which ignores non-positive password length values before generating the PPD password pattern.

The DHI cups package backports the upstream scheduler option filtering fix from https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/8d0f51cac24cb5bf949c5b6a221e51a150d982e3 as dhi-cve-2026-34980-filter-option-values.patch, which filters control characters from option values and excludes special PPD keywords from job keyword updates.

The DHI cups package backports the upstream scheduler options allocation fix from https://github.com/OpenPrinting/cups/commit/0ff8897367c7341f2500770c3977038cdd7c0214 as dhi-cve-2026-34979-expand-options-allocation.patch, which includes all IPP attribute types in the allocation size calculation before serializing job options.
